ignore.reason: Endian, tag, value, size and copy primitives; Python represents byte order, comparison, slicing and copies natively.
Diagnostic producers for C format and codec implementations; Python consumes diagnostics but does not build them.
Wrappers that call their bound `_diag` counterpart with a NULL diagnostic; Python always raises structured diagnostics, so they add no separate path.
Tag/Value forms that build a `tlv_element_t` and call the Element entry points; Python passes the Element to `tlv_write_element_diag()` and `tlv_writer_write_element_diag()` directly.
`tlv_writer_write_element()` after the same argument and native-size checks, without diagnostics; `Writer.write_element()` re-encodes through `tlv_writer_write_element_diag()`.
